about: Each fixture is a word-list file and what each reader must do with it: the check (client/scripts/i18n-brand-words.js) and the translation script (client/scripts/translate-i18n-anthropic.py). A verdict is "refuse", or the set of words the reader accepts the file with. The check accepts a file only when the translation script reads the same words from it (R266.2). "real" is the words both read from i18n-do-not-translate.yaml.

03-repeated-section.yaml.shape: product_nouns a second time, with one item

06-unicode-escape.yaml.shape: an item "Caf\u00e9", which YAML reads as Café

08-tab-indented-item.yaml.shape: an item indented with a tab

09-four-space-item.yaml.shape: an item indented four spaces among two-space items

10-one-space-item.yaml.shape: an item indented one space among two-space items

12-other-order.yaml.shape: the three sections in another order

13-comment-without-space.yaml.shape: a comment straight after an item's closing quote, with no space

14-tab-comment-line.yaml.shape: a comment line indented with a tab

15-line-separator-in-comment.yaml.shape: a comment holding U+2028, which YAML ends the line at, then an item

16-lone-cr-in-comment.yaml.shape: a comment holding a lone CR, which YAML ends the line at, then an item

17-next-line-in-comment.yaml.shape: a comment holding U+0085, which YAML ends the line at, then an item

18-control-character.yaml.shape: a comment holding U+0001, which YAML refuses

19-nbsp-comment-line.yaml.shape: a comment line indented with U+00A0

20-tab-before-comment.yaml.shape: a tab between an item's closing quote and its comment

21-not-utf8.yaml.shape: a comment holding the byte 0xFF, which is not UTF-8

22-space-before-word.yaml.shape: an item " Diary", with a space before the word

23-space-after-word.yaml.shape: an item "Diary ", with a space after the word

24-nbsp-before-word.yaml.shape: an item " Diary", with U+00A0 before the word

25-tab-after-word.yaml.shape: an item "Diary\t", with a tab after the word

26-repeated-word.yaml.shape: Echo listed in product_nouns and again in shard_proper_nouns
